evidence.observation: Reboiler temperature reads ~424-429 °C, physically implausible versus T702 ~76 °C and a stable ~65 °C column profile, and drifts steadily upward
Column profile flat and stable (58-76 °C) at PY23 ~399 mbar, consistent with steady operation
Reflux and distillate flows erratic (0.005-0.26 and 0.25-0.92 L/h) while FYI702 stays pinned near 3.9, suggesting ratio value not tracking measured flows
